# Benchmarks

<!-- Generated by `sail-bench report` from bench/results/*.json. Do not edit. -->

Every benchmark round also runs the conformance comparison (charter: a speedup that coincides with any verdict difference is a bug, not a result). Times are medians over rounds, with the spread shown as (min–max). Units run one at a time.

The reference platform for published numbers is Linux x86-64 (ADR 0010). Results from other platforms are secondary. Result names ending in `devload` were measured on a development machine under other load, so expect wide spreads.
